build_qformer_model: build a Qformer model with configurable cross-attention frequency and query token count for BLIP-2
create_bert_embeddings: create BertEmbeddings that combine word position and query embeddings with LayerNorm and dropout
test_bert_encoder: test the BertEncoder forward pass with gradient checkpointing and cross-attention support
review_bert_layer: review the BertLayer to understand how query and text tokens are processed separately with cross-attention
summarize_bert_lm_head: summarize the BertLMHeadModel that performs causal language modeling with cross-attention to vision encoder states
